plain.summary: A lease gives one principal the Job for 1 minute at a time, renewed by heartbeat at least every 20 seconds. The runner expires a lapsed lease within 5 seconds. While a lease is active only its holder writes; each acquire gives a new token, which the holder presents as preconditions {"Lease": {"token": n}}.

full.summary: A lease gives one principal the Job for 30 seconds at a time, renewed by heartbeat at least every 10 seconds, and held at most the instance's timeLimitMs milliseconds, else 90 seconds. The runner expires a lapsed lease within 2 seconds; an expiry moves status from running to queued. After 3 expiries it is not leased again, and that expiry moves status from running or queued to failed instead. While a lease is active only its holder writes, but for Comments.comment; each acquire gives a new token, which the holder presents as preconditions {"Lease": {"token": n}} on every write. The runner sends the holder of an active lease directive rebase when the plan link's target gains a revision past the pinned one or a release, directive reread when the notes link's target gains a revision or a release and directive reload when the recipe link's target gains a revision or a release past the pinned one; an instance with no lease held hears nothing, and its next holder nothing either.

update.doNotUseWhen: Do not write under another principal's active lease; the holder presents its token as preconditions {"Lease": {"token": n}}. timeLimitMs does not change while a lease is held.
